interface.title: ActinoEdit — CRISPR Design Toolkit for Actinomycetes (v0.4.0)
interface.field: microbial genome engineering / synthetic biology (CRISPR guide design in actinomycetes)
interface.stage_of_work: experiment design — choosing and vetting sgRNA guides before cloning
interface.what_it_is_for: Scan a microbial genome around a target gene for CRISPR guides, score them with an organism-specific profile, check off-targets, CRISPRi placement and BGC overlap, and export a shareable guide-design report.

data.note: Used the bundled Streptomyces demo pre-loaded on '/' (/work/app/examples/demo_genome.fasta + demo_annotation.gff, optional demo_bgc.bed), re-applied with 'Load Demo Data'. Contig1 is 603 bp; geneA maps to contig1:1-300. The supplied test files could not be uploaded: the upload handler raises "'UploadEventArguments' object has no attribute 'content'" (screens/014.webp), so only the 'or path' text fields work. The app was served with --demo, so '/' renders the demo design page rather than the main page.

tree.general: Pick a small set of trustworthy targeting reagents for one gene and hand them on as a documented, shareable design
tree.specific: Design, score and vet sgRNA guides against a target gene in a Streptomyces genome and export the guide design

features.name: Search-parameter panel with target resolution and guarded errors
features.general: A compact form that turns a reference sequence, a named or coordinate-specified region and a few search rules into one runnable job, refusing impossible requests with a specific reason
features.specific: Input Files + Organism Profile + CRISPR Parameters + Target cards feeding one Run Design button; the Target field accepts a locus_tag/gene name or contig:start-end and resolves it against the GFF
steps: Press Load Demo Data (or type genome/annotation paths) and pick gff or gbk
Pick an organism profile from the six on offer
Choose Design Mode knockout or crispri and leave PAM / Spacer Length / Max Mismatches at NGG / 20 / 3
Type the target as a gene name or as contig:start-end
Press Run Design and read the inline red message if the genome path, region or a parameter is bad
Note the guard is incomplete: an unknown contig name in the coordinate form returns silently with no guides and no message
serves_tasks: set the rules the search will follow
say which stretch of sequence to work on

features.name: Background run with progress feedback
features.general: A long analysis is handed to a background job so the form stays usable: pressing go acknowledges the request and a progress card reports the job rather than freezing the page
features.specific: Run Design starts a background task: a 'Design started' toast appears and a Progress card is shown while the pipeline scans and scores guides; the result is fetched from the Download Results card afterwards
steps: Fill the input, parameter and target cards
Press Run Design and read the 'Design started' toast
Watch the Progress card while the job runs
When it is done, download CSV/Excel/HTML to read the result (the on-screen tables do not refresh on their own)
serves_tasks: repeat the whole assessment for a second region

features.name: On-screen result review: summary chips, ranked candidate table and filters
features.general: A short summary of what was analysed plus a ranked table of candidates with their key measures and a verdict badge, narrowed by a couple of threshold controls
features.specific: Design Summary (Target / Region / Guides) above a Guide Candidates table with GC%, Off-targets total, score and colour-coded recommendation, plus Recommendation Filter and Max Off-targets fields
steps: Run a design, then load or reload the page — the summary and rows are built at page render, so they are stale until then
Read the chips: Target geneA / Region contig1:1-300 / Guides 2
Read each row's GC%, Off-targets total, score and recommendation badge
Set Recommendation Filter and/or Max Off-targets to narrow the list
Reload again to see a filter take effect — set on an already-rendered page, neither changed the rows in this session
serves_tasks: read the scored candidates in the interface itself
narrow the candidate list to the ones worth ordering

features.name: Design-mode switch that changes which columns the result carries
features.general: One selector that re-runs the same analysis under a different intervention model, so the result gains or loses a block of mode-specific measures
features.specific: Design Mode knockout ↔ crispri; under crispri the export fills crispri_region_type, distance_to_start_codon and target_strand_relation, under knockout they stay blank
steps: Set Design Mode to crispri
Press Run Design
Download the HTML report or CSV and read crispri_region_type, distance_to_start_codon and target_strand_relation (cds / 176 and 237 / non_template for geneA)
Switch back to knockout, re-run, re-download and confirm those columns are empty
Expect the mode block only in the downloads — the on-screen candidate table has no CRISPRi columns
serves_tasks: check the candidates sit where a silencing reagent needs to sit

features.name: Optional region-overlay annotation of candidates

Press Run Design again

features.name: Three-format export of the scored design
features.general: One result set written out as a flat table for analysis, a spreadsheet for colleagues, and a formatted report with warnings and a ranked top list
features.specific: Download Results card with Download CSV / Download Excel / Download HTML, all driven by the last Run Design
steps: Run a design
Press Download CSV for the full 28-column guide table (guide_id … bgc_id, bgc_type, bgc_context, crispri_region_type, distance_to_start_codon, target_strand_relation)
Press Download Excel for the same as actinoedit_report.xlsx
Press Download HTML for Target Information, a GC-content Warnings list, Guide Candidates (Top 20) and the Off-Target Summary
Do not expect the report's Design Parameters table to record the run settings — it lists only 'source: ActinoEdit Web'
serves_tasks: hand the finished design on to collaborators
check whether candidates match elsewhere in the sequence

features.name: Local project database for saving and browsing designs (not reached)
features.general: A local store that keeps finished designs under named projects alongside the organisms and reference sequences they came from, so earlier results can be re-opened and re-exported instead of re-run
features.specific: Projects / Organisms / Genomes pages plus a 'Save current guides to DB' card on the main design page, backed by a local SQLite database
steps: Initialise the store with 'actinoedit db init' from the CLI
Open the main (non-demo) design page and save a finished run to a named project
Create or delete projects on /projects and link an organism and a genome
Re-open a project and export its saved guides

not_done: Base-editing feasibility screening: no control for it anywhere in the web UI, and no editable-base / codon / amino-acid columns in the CSV (28 columns, none base-edit related) or the HTML report. It appears to be CLI-only in this build.

Saving guides to the local project database and browsing/exporting them later: the demo page carries no DB card, and the main page and DB pages need 'actinoedit db init', which requires a shell I do not have (screens/003.webp).

Uploading the supplied demo_genome.fasta / demo_annotation.gff / demo_bgc.bed through the file pickers: the handler throws "'UploadEventArguments' object has no attribute 'content'" (screens/014.webp). Only the 'or path' text fields work, so all runs used the bundled copies under /work/app/examples/.

Changing Spacer Length or Max Mismatches away from their defaults: entering a value in either number field makes the run fail with "'float' object cannot be interpreted as an integer" (screens/020.webp, which shows Spacer Length 15 with PAM NNN and target contig1:1-603 — 15 is the field minimum, so the 12 that was typed could not be submitted at all). Both parameters could therefore only be used at 20 and 3.

Showing the Recommendation Filter or Max Off-targets controls change the listed candidates: both accept input and the filtering is applied when rows are built, but on an already-rendered page nothing changed in-session — Max Off-targets 0 left the table as it was and re-exported a byte-identical 82693-byte CSV (screens/029.webp, screens/037.webp), and Recommendation Filter = excellent with Max Off-targets = 10 still listed both 'avoid' guides with 132 and 145 off-targets (check/screens/017.webp, check/screens/018.webp).

Designing against geneB: its GFF coordinates (400-800) run past the end of the 603 bp demo contig, so the bundled demo data cannot support a second named gene (screens/035.webp). A coordinate target was used instead.
Getting any feedback for a mistyped contig name: the coordinate form with an unknown contig (contig_1:1000-2000) returned no guides and no error message at all, so this input is a silent dead end.

Capturing the Design Mode field while set to crispri: the mode was selected and the crispri-only columns did fill in the export, but screens/030.webp shows the dropdown with knockout still selected and screens/031.webp is scrolled past the field, so no kept screen records the switch.
